alsa_output.usb-SteelSeries_Arctis_Nova_7-00.analog-stereo:playback_FL
  |<- penguinwave_eq_chat_out:output_FL
  |<- penguinwave_eq_game_out:output_FL
alsa_output.usb-SteelSeries_Arctis_Nova_7-00.analog-stereo:playback_FR
  |<- penguinwave_eq_chat_out:output_FR
  |<- penguinwave_eq_game_out:output_FR
game_sink:monitor_FL
  |-> penguinwave_eq_game:input_FL
game_sink:monitor_FR
  |-> penguinwave_eq_game:input_FR
chat_sink:monitor_FL
  |-> penguinwave_eq_chat:input_FL
chat_sink:monitor_FR
  |-> penguinwave_eq_chat:input_FR
penguinwave_eq_chat:input_FL
  |<- chat_sink:monitor_FL
penguinwave_eq_chat:input_FR
  |<- chat_sink:monitor_FR
penguinwave_eq_chat_out:output_FL
  |-> alsa_output.usb-SteelSeries_Arctis_Nova_7-00.analog-stereo:playback_FL
  |-> bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FL
penguinwave_eq_chat_out:output_FR
  |-> alsa_output.usb-SteelSeries_Arctis_Nova_7-00.analog-stereo:playback_FR
  |-> bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FR
penguinwave_eq_game:input_FL
  |<- game_sink:monitor_FL
penguinwave_eq_game:input_FR
  |<- game_sink:monitor_FR
penguinwave_eq_game_out:output_FL
  |-> alsa_output.usb-SteelSeries_Arctis_Nova_7-00.analog-stereo:playback_FL
  |-> bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FL
penguinwave_eq_game_out:output_FR
  |-> alsa_output.usb-SteelSeries_Arctis_Nova_7-00.analog-stereo:playback_FR
  |-> bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FR
bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:monitor_FL
  |-> cava:input_FL
bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:monitor_FR
  |-> cava:input_FR
bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FL
  |<- penguinwave_eq_chat_out:output_FL
  |<- penguinwave_eq_game_out:output_FL
  |<- Brave:output_FL
bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FR
  |<- penguinwave_eq_chat_out:output_FR
  |<- penguinwave_eq_game_out:output_FR
  |<- Brave:output_FR
Brave:output_FL
  |-> bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FL
Brave:output_FR
  |-> bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:playback_FR
cava:input_FL
  |<- bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:monitor_FL
cava:input_FR
  |<- bluez_output.AA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF.1:monitor_FR
